about_the_game:
L is a wandering knight, driven by a deep desire to discover his true self and the reason for his existence.

In The Darkblade, you follow L's journey across the land — meeting friends, allies, rivals, enemies, and uncovering hidden truths along the way.

Key Features

  • Slay Monsters with Souls-like Experience.

  • Upgrading Skills, Equipment and Dark Core.

  • Adventuring across the land to find the truth.

  • Bringing pet with in adventure.

name: The Darkblade Demo
short_description: The Darkblade is a souls-like 2D singleplayer RPG where you battle through cursed lands, master deadly combat, and uncover the truth behind a mysterious stone core—all while adventuring with a loyal, cute companion by your side.
